complete.label: Partly valued
complete.body: At least one holding has no usable price or exchange rate, so it is left out of these totals rather than counted as zero.

free_cash.label: Free cash
free_cash.body: Money in your accounts that is not in any position. A savings or deposit product is not counted here — its balance belongs to that product.

nominal_return.label: Nominal return
nominal_return.body: What your invested money has earned since you started, in currency terms. Cash sitting uninvested is not counted against it.

real_return.label: Real return
real_return.body: Your return with inflation taken out: what the portfolio gained in buying power, not just in currency. Measured from your first holding to today.

total_value.label: Total value
total_value.body: Everything you hold at its most recent recorded price, converted to your reporting currency, plus the cash sitting in your accounts.

cash.label: Cash
cash.body: This account's uninvested balance, converted to your reporting currency.

complete.label: Partly valued
complete.body: Something in this account could not be priced, so its subtotal is short of it rather than counting it as zero.

contribution_room.label: Contribution room
contribution_room.body: Your own record of how much you may still contribute this year. It is checked against the published limit and shown to you, never enforced.

registration_br_prev_pgbl.label: PGBL private pension
registration_br_prev_pgbl.body: A Brazilian pension plan whose contributions you can deduct from taxable income, up to the legal limit. Tax at withdrawal falls on the whole balance, not only on the gain.

registration_br_prev_vgbl.label: VGBL private pension
registration_br_prev_vgbl.body: A Brazilian pension plan whose contributions are not deductible. In exchange, tax at withdrawal falls only on what it gained, not on the whole balance.

registration_br_taxable.label: Taxable (BR)
registration_br_taxable.body: An ordinary Brazilian account with no tax wrapper. Whatever tax advantage you have comes from the instruments inside it, not from the account.

registration_ca_fhsa.label: FHSA
registration_ca_fhsa.body: A Canadian first home savings account, combining a deduction on the way in with tax-free qualified withdrawals.

registration_ca_non_registered.label: Non-registered (CA)
registration_ca_non_registered.body: An ordinary Canadian account with no registered wrapper around it.

registration_ca_rrsp.label: RRSP
registration_ca_rrsp.body: A Canadian retirement savings plan. Contributions reduce your taxable income now, and withdrawals are taxed as income later.

registration_ca_tfsa.label: TFSA
registration_ca_tfsa.body: A Canadian tax-free savings account. Growth inside it and withdrawals from it are not taxed.

registration_us_401k.label: 401(k)
registration_us_401k.body: A US retirement plan offered through an employer. Contributions and withdrawals follow that plan's own rules.

registration_us_ira_roth.label: Roth IRA
registration_us_ira_roth.body: A US retirement account funded after tax. Qualified withdrawals, including the growth, are not taxed.

registration_us_ira_traditional.label: Traditional IRA
registration_us_ira_traditional.body: A US retirement account funded before tax. The money grows untaxed and withdrawals are taxed as income.

registration_us_taxable.label: Taxable (US)
registration_us_taxable.body: An ordinary US brokerage account with no tax wrapper around it.

tax_regime.label: Tax regime
tax_regime.body: Whether the plan's rate is progressive, rising with the amount, or regressive, falling the longer the money stays in.

taxed_on.label: Taxed on
taxed_on.body: Whether tax at withdrawal falls on the whole amount or only on what the plan gained.

average_cost.label: Average cost
average_cost.body: What one unit of the part you still hold cost you on average, fees included.

cost_basis_remaining.label: Cost basis remaining
cost_basis_remaining.body: What the part you still hold originally cost. Selling removes a share of it, following your account's country rule.

costs.label: Costs
costs.body: Standalone fees charged against this position, such as custody or management. Fees paid on a trade are inside what you invested, not here.

current_price.label: Price
current_price.body: The most recent recorded price for one unit of this asset. The date beside it tells you how current it is.

current_value.label: Current value
current_value.body: What this position is worth at its most recent recorded price, converted to your reporting currency.

holding_period_days.label: Held for
holding_period_days.body: How long you have held this position, counted from your first purchase.

income_received.label: Income received
income_received.body: What this position has paid you in dividends, distributions or interest.

invested.label: Invested
invested.body: Everything you have ever put into this position, including the fees on those trades. Selling does not reduce it.

principal.label: Principal
principal.body: The balance you hold in this instrument, for products measured by amount rather than by units.

quantity.label: Position
quantity.body: How many units you hold right now. Instruments measured by balance rather than units show their principal instead.

quote_date.label: Valued on
quote_date.body: The date of the price behind this value. Buying records a price, so a position is rarely unpriced — this date is what tells a fresh price from an old one.

real_return.label: Real return
real_return.body: This position's return with inflation taken out, measured from the day you opened it to today.

realized_gain.label: Realized gain
realized_gain.body: What selling actually produced: the proceeds less what the sold part had cost you.

total_return.label: Total return
total_return.body: What this position earned on the money you put in: gains you have taken, gains on paper, and income received, against what you paid.

unrealized_gain.label: Unrealized gain
unrealized_gain.body: What the part you still hold has gained on paper: its value today against what it cost. Nothing is realised until you sell.

monthly_return.label: Return
monthly_return.body: How the portfolio performed that month with your deposits taken out, so putting money in never looks like a gain.

net_flow.label: Net deposits
net_flow.body: Money you moved in or out that month, not money you made. Buys, sells, income and fees are not here — those are what the return measures.

partial.label: So far
partial.body: This month is not over, so the figure is today's rather than a month-end one. It is not comparable with the completed months above it.

total_value.label: Total value
total_value.body: What the portfolio was worth at the end of that month, using the prices on record for that date.

expected.label: Projected
expected.body: What you already hold, carried forward at the pace your own record has kept. It assumes no further deposits and is not a prediction.

monthly_profit_rate.label: Monthly result
monthly_profit_rate.body: What each sale returned, divided by the months you held it. There is no minimum holding period, so something sold days after buying can show a very large rate.

realized_only.label: Measured on sales
realized_only.body: Only what you have sold is ranked here. An asset you still hold has no realised result to measure, however well it is doing.

by_archetype.label: By type
by_archetype.body: Your portfolio split by kind of instrument: cash deposits, fixed income, listed securities, funds and crypto.

by_country.label: By country
by_country.body: Your portfolio split by where the account is registered, which is what fixes its tax treatment and its cost basis rule.

by_currency.label: By currency
by_currency.body: Your portfolio split by the currency each instrument is priced in, not by the currency of the account holding it.

invested.label: Invested
invested.body: What you paid for the part you still hold in this slice, including the fees on those trades.

slice_incomplete.label: Partly valued
slice_incomplete.body: Something in this slice could not be priced, so its value and share cover the rest of it.

value.label: Value now
value.body: What this slice is worth today at the latest recorded prices, converted to your reporting currency.

weight.label: Share
weight.body: This slice's part of everything that could be priced. Holdings without a usable price are outside both the slice and the total.

actual.label: Actual
actual.body: What this position has actually returned so far — gains taken, gains on paper, and income received, against what you put in.

band.label: Tolerance
band.body: How far from the expected return still counts as on track: a tenth of it, or half a percentage point, whichever is wider.

expected.label: Expected
expected.body: What your target says this position should have returned by now, given how long you have held it.

status.label: Status
status.body: How this position stands against its target: ahead of it, on track within tolerance, behind it, or through the loss limit you set.

income_attributed.label: Income
income_attributed.body: This purchase's share of the income the position received, split across your open purchases by their size.

invested.label: Invested
invested.body: What this one purchase cost you, fees included. Selling out of it does not reduce the figure.

lot_return.label: Return
lot_return.body: What this one purchase earned on what you put into it — the same measure as the position's return, narrowed to this contribution.

quantity_remaining.label: Remaining
quantity_remaining.body: How much of this particular purchase you still hold, after the sales drawn against it.

realized_gain.label: Realized gain
realized_gain.body: What selling out of this particular purchase produced, against what that part had cost.

status.label: Status
status.body: Whether this purchase still holds anything. It closes when the last unit bought in it has been sold.

unrealized_gain.label: Unrealized gain
unrealized_gain.body: What the part of this purchase you still hold has gained on paper, against what it cost.

method.label: Cost basis method
method.body: Which part of your holding a sale draws from: the weighted average in Brazil and Canada, the oldest purchase first in the US. Your account's country decides, not you.

chain.label: Network
chain.body: The blockchain this token settles on. The same token can exist on several, and they are not interchangeable.

compounding.label: Compounding
compounding.body: How often the accrued interest is added to the balance and starts earning in its turn: daily or monthly.

coupon_frequency.label: Coupon frequency
coupon_frequency.body: How often that coupon is paid: twice a year, once a year, or never. A paper with a coupon needs one; a paper without one must not have it.

deposit_insurance.label: Deposit insurance
deposit_insurance.body: Which guarantee fund covers this instrument if the issuer fails: FGC in Brazil, FDIC in the US, CDIC in Canada. Coverage limits are not tracked.

early_redemption.label: Early redemption
early_redemption.body: Whether this paper can be cashed in before its maturity date, usually at a worse rate than holding it to term.

exchange.label: Exchange
exchange.body: The venue this security trades on, which is what makes its ticker unambiguous.

face_value.label: Face value
face_value.body: What the issuer pays back per unit at maturity — the paper's stated denomination. It is not what you paid for it, and not what it is worth today.

fund_category.label: Fund category
fund_category.body: The fund's own category label, as its manager describes it.

instrument_kind.label: Instrument
instrument_kind.body: Whether this paper is a certificate issued by a bank you hold an account with, or a bond, which may be government paper with no institution behind it.

isin.label: ISIN
isin.body: The security's international identification number. Unlike a ticker, it identifies the instrument worldwide.

issue_date.label: Issue date
issue_date.body: When the paper was issued, which is when its term and its accrual start.

issuer_type.label: Issuer type
issuer_type.body: Who issued the paper: a government, a company, a municipality, or a bank.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.body: Whether you can take the money out whenever you want, or only when the paper matures.

management_fee.label: Management fee
management_fee.body: The annual fee the manager charges on what it holds for you. Recorded as information — it is not deducted from any figure here.

maturity_date.label: Maturity date
maturity_date.body: When the issuer repays the paper. Reaching it closes every open purchase in the position at once.

pays_distributions.label: Pays distributions
pays_distributions.body: Whether this security pays dividends or distributions, as opposed to returning everything through its price.

performance_fee.label: Performance fee
performance_fee.body: The fee charged on returns above the fund's benchmark. Recorded as information — it is not deducted from any figure here.

rate_index.label: Rate index
rate_index.body: The index a floating or inflation-linked rate tracks: CDI, Selic, IPCA or IGP-M. The rate beside it is then read as a percentage of that index.

rate_type.label: Rate type
rate_type.body: How the yield is set: fixed for the whole term, floating against an index, or linked to inflation plus a spread.

security_type.label: Security type
security_type.body: What kind of listed security this is: a stock, an ETF, a REIT, or a Brazilian FII.

symbol.label: Symbol
symbol.body: The coin or token's ticker, such as BTC or ETH.

tax_advantaged.label: Tax-advantaged instrument
tax_advantaged.body: Whether this instrument itself carries a Brazilian exemption, as LCI, LCA and Poupança do. In the US and Canada the advantage belongs to the account instead.

ticker.label: Ticker
ticker.body: The symbol this security trades under on its exchange. The same symbol can mean different companies on different exchanges.

unit_price.label: Unit price
unit_price.body: What one unit of the fund is currently worth, as published by the manager. This is how a NAV fund is priced.

cost_removed.label: Cost removed
cost_removed.body: What the part you sold had cost you. Which part that is follows your account's country rule, not your choice.

fully_sold.label: Partly sold
fully_sold.body: Whether anything is left in the purchase these sales came from. It describes the purchase itself, not the sales you filtered to.

kind.label: Type
kind.body: What ended the position: a sale, a redemption, a withdrawal, or the paper reaching maturity. A maturity closes every open purchase at once.

proceeds.label: Proceeds
proceeds.body: What the sale brought in, after the fees on that trade.

profit.label: Profit
profit.body: What you actually made on the sale: the proceeds less what the sold part had cost.

profit_rate.label: Result
profit_rate.body: What the sale returned against what that purchase cost, trade fees included, in the asset's own currency. Custody and management fees are not in it.

quantity_sold.label: Quantity sold
quantity_sold.body: How many units left this purchase in the sales shown.
